subject: Pricing and retention options for observability vendors — Datadog vs Grafana Cloud
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anya Patel <anya.patel@datadog.com>, Samir Rao <samir@grafanacloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability retention: capacity, pricing & options for renewal

Hi Anya and Samir,

We’re kicking off the renewal discussion for our observability stack and need concrete options for log retention add-ons. A few constraints from our side:
- Current ingest: ~6 TB/day, projected to 12 TB/day in 12 months.
- Bulk of usage is low-velocity debug logs; only ~10% hot queries.
- Target: retain full index for 30 days, then move to cold storage for 12+ months with reasonably fast restore (24–48h).

Can you each provide:
1) Pricing for 30d hot + 12m cold (per GB/month and any egress/restore fees).
2) Technical approach (native retention vs object store tiering vs archive export).
3) Any volume commitments or discounts available and the timeline to provision extra retention.
4) A one-page SOW or proposal we can share with Finance.

Attached is our current usage extract and a simple TCO worksheet. Please drop proposals and an intro calendar window for a short 30-min alignment.

Attachments: redwood_usage_snapshot.csv, retention_tco_template.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Anya Patel <anya.patel@datadog.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability retention: capacity, pricing & options for renewal

Hi Karthik — thanks for the details. Quick summary from Datadog side (see attached PDF for full quote):

1) Pricing:
- Hot 30d: included in current plan (volume tiers apply).
- Cold 12m: $0.008/GB/month when stored in Datadog Archive; restore fee $0.12/GB.
- Volume discount: 15% off cold storage for a 12-month committed contract at your projected 12 TB/day.

2) Technical approach:
- Native Archive tier (managed object store behind the scenes) with lifecycle policies.
- On-demand restores exposed via API and console (we guarantee restore starts within 6–36h depending on size).

3) Timeline & provisioning:
- We can enable additional retention within 48h after order. For committed discounts, we need a signed order form + PO.

4) SOW / next steps:
- Attached: dd_pricing_proposal_Q3.pdf (summary + T&Cs).
- Proposed 30-min sync: Thu 17 Jun, 10:00–10:30 PT.

Notes: we can also include a temporary credit for migration costs (~$10k) if you commit to 12-months up front. Happy to walk Laura/Markus through the restore SLAs.

Best,
Anya Patel
Enterprise Sales — Datadog
Attachment: dd_pricing_proposal_Q3.pdf (stub)

From: Samir Rao <samir@grafanacloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability retention: capacity, pricing & options for renewal

Karthik — appreciate the note and context. High-level Grafana Cloud option below; attached is a worksheet with line-item math.

1) Pricing (illustrative):
- Hot 30d: existing ingestion pricing applies.
- Cold 12m via object-store tiering: $0.0045/GB/month (ingress free), restore API calls billed at $0.06/GB.
- For integrations with S3/GCS we recommend using your own cloud bucket for long-term retention which reduces ongoing platform costs.

2) Technical approach:
- Native warm-to-cold lifecycle with optional export to customer-managed S3/GCS.
- If you want platform-managed cold, we offer managed object storage for an additional flat fee and a 10% management discount if committed for 12 months.

3) Pilot & timeline:
- Suggest a 30-day pilot on a subset of indexes (we can onboard in 7 days).
- Pilot includes a one-time migration script and upfront analysis (SOW attached).

Attachment: grafana_retention_quote.xlsx

On Thu 17 Jun I can join the call at 10:00 PT or we can do 11:30 PT if that works better.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Solutions Architect, Grafana Cloud
Attachment: grafana_retention_quote.xlsx (stub)

Thanks both — helpful outlines. Internal ask: Laura/Markus, can you two do a quick TCO run vs our retention_tco_template and recommend: 1) platform-managed cold (Datadog managed) vs 2) customer-managed object store (Grafana suggestion) vs 3) 3rd-party archiver (LogRetention Solutions also included in the thread) by EOD tomorrow?

Key decision factors for Finance: total monthly cost (including restores), expected operational overhead (on-call + runbook complexity), and migration/one-time onboarding fees.

Neha — please flag any procurement lead time or PO constraints. I’ve dropped the proposals and the TCO worksheet into the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleRetentionModel
